TextElement.Str: Edit account opens the masked settings form. Blank password/PIN retain saved values. Clear session keeps the saved account. Forget removes it. Tasker backups can contain credentials.
Cold defaults to 62 F without defrost; hot to 81 F with defrost. Each preset is editable. Seats and steering-wheel heat stay off. Editing sends no car command. %SFDGuiPending
%SFDGuiPending Accepted is different from completed. Check command follows the existing transaction. Resolve unknown requires checking the car and never resends it.
Regular uses saved climate settings. Cold/hot use their own presets. Starts ask you to confirm the car is outdoors. %SFDGuiPending

FIRST USE Account > Edit account > Connect. Choose your car if asked.
DAILY USE Controls has lock, unlock, regular/cold/hot start and stop. Climate edits each preset independently.
WATCH Account > Watch settings enables signed Join commands. Test connection on the watch first. Join receipt means sent to the phone; Command shows the car result.
RESULTS Status is the last vehicle sample. An unresolved outcome blocks another command. Check the command or the car before resolving it.
Opening pages does not contact Hyundai. Horn and lights are absent.
This is the last status sample Hyundai returned. A refresh request can still return cached data. Unknown means no recognized value. %SFDGuiVehicle
